Use & cutting safety

Updated 31 October 2026.

Toolnest helps create foam pocket designs from photos. You remain responsible for checking dimensions, permissions to use imported material, and the safe operation of your equipment.

Check before you cut

AI tracing, calibration and smoothing can introduce errors. Print calibration targets at actual size, verify the reference line, inspect outlines and test a sample pocket. Raised tools, lens distortion, lighting and print scale affect accuracy. No precision or fit is guaranteed.

Exported geometry and the 3D preview are design aids. Confirm scale, pocket depths, stock thickness, clearances, tooling, feeds, speeds and workholding in your CAM software. Simulate toolpaths and follow the machine manufacturer's instructions before machining. A 3D preview is not a safety certification or a simulation of the cutting machine.

Backups and access

Keep your own project and library backups. Browser storage can be cleared and cloud access can fail. See the privacy notice for optional sync, third-party services and deletion controls.

Cost and scope

This version has no checkout, paid subscription or automatic renewal. Toolnest is a design tool, with no conversational assistant or mental-health advice feature.
